# growthOS

> growthOS is an AI-powered SEO, AEO, and GEO (AI-visibility) growth engine.
> Connect a site, scan issues, approve safe fixes, and deploy with verify/rollback.

## Preferred pages
- Homepage: https://grothos.in/
- SEO vs AEO vs GEO: https://grothos.in/seo-aeo-geo
- Compare vs SEO tools: https://grothos.in/compare
- Pricing: https://grothos.in/pricing
- Signup: https://grothos.in/signup
- Login: https://grothos.in/login

## Product summary
- Connect modes: WordPress (+ plugin), GitHub, ZIP upload, Live URL
- Loop: Connect → Scan → Propose → Approve → Deploy → Verify → Rollback
- Beta change classes: meta title, meta description, FAQ schema, canonical URLs
